response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) as count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE oe.expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: The expirespot column stores full ISO 8601 timestamp strings with microsecond precision. The schema definition shows text(6)—which would only hold 6 characters—but the documentation and request context indicate timestamps 19+ characters long (e.g., '2025-05-10 15:00:00'). This appears to be a schema definition error; the column must actually have sufficient capacity.
